dct_description_sm: To record trends in concentrations of various 'legacy' organochlorines in a population of ringed seals (Phoca hispida) which form the basis of a subsistence hunt in the region. The project continues previous studies of this population which began in the early 1970s: Addison R.F. and Smith T.G. (1974). Organochlorine residue levels in Arctic ringed seals: variation with age and sex.  Oikos 25: 335-337; Addison R.F., Zinck M.E. and Smith T.G. (1986). PCBs have declined more than DDT group residues in Arctic ringed seals (Phoca hispida) between 1972 and 1981.  Env. Sci. Technol. 20: 253-256; Addison R.F. and Smith T.G. (1998). Trends in organochlorine residue concentrations in ringed seal (Phoca hispida) from Holman, NWT, 1972 - 1991.  Arctic 51: 253-261; Addison, R.F.; M.G. Ikonomou, M.P.Fernandez, and T. Smith. 2005. PCDD/F and PCB concentrations in Arctic Ringed Seals (Phoca Hispida) have not changed between 1981 and 2000. Sci. Tot. Environ. 351-352:  301-311.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Persistent organic pollutants (POPs)
dct_title_s: Temporal trends in 'legacy' organochlorines in ringed seals from Ulukhaktok, Northwest Territories
